identity.name: PropStack AI
identity.vibe: Professional, minimalist, data-dense, authoritative yet hospitable.
principles: Density with Breath: High data density in dashboards, but macro spacing in marketing.
Swiss Grid: Strict alignment, reliable layouts, no floating elements without purpose.
Texture over Gradient: Use subtle noise or matte finishes instead of shiny gradients.
Function is Beauty: If it doesn't help the user manage property, remove it.

typography.instructions: Import these fonts in your main CSS file or index.html from Google Fonts.

secondary_font.name: Public Sans
secondary_font.usage: Body text, form inputs, long reading

rules: HEADINGS: Use Manrope. Tracking tight (-0.02em). Bold (700) for H1/H2.
BODY: Use Public Sans. Leading relaxed (1.6).
DATA: All currency and percentage numbers MUST be JetBrains Mono.

colors.mode_strategy: System preference default, with manual toggle in settings/navbar.
usage_rules: PRIMARY COLOR is strictly for Brand Identity and Primary Actions.
Use 'Electric Blue' (Chart 2 in light, Chart 1 in dark) for active states and data highlights.
NEVER use gradients for backgrounds. Use flat colors or subtle noise.
Borders should be subtle. Use 'border' variable.

buttons.style: h-10 px-4 py-2 rounded-md font-medium transition-all active:scale-95

inputs.style: h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm ring-offset-background file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50

sidebar.style: w-64 border-r bg-card h-screen fixed left-0 top-0 hidden md:block
sidebar.item: flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2 rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-colors hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground

charts.style: Minimalist, thin lines, custom tooltips with high contrast.

visual_enhancers.noise_texture: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 200 200' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='noiseFilter'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.65' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23noiseFilter)' opacity='0.05'/%3E%3C/svg%3E")

properties.layout: Grid of Cards with Image Header
properties.card_style: Image top (h-48), Content bottom. Badge for status (Occupied/Vacant).

accessibility_checklist: Interactive elements must have focus rings.
Use semantic HTML (main, section, nav, button).
All images must have alt text.
universal_guidelines: Animation: Use framer-motion for page transitions and list entrances.
Forms: Use Shadcn Form + React Hook Form + Zod.
Data Test IDs: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes.
